systems.system: Burundi Backbone System (BBS) national fibre backbone and its Bujumbura metropolitan network
systems.owner: BBS, formed as a consortium of ONATEL and other operators (Africel, U-COM, Cbinet, Econet)
systems.tiers: national backbone; a metropolitan network in the Mairie de Bujumbura built in parallel with ONATEL's

systems.system: ONATEL metropolitan fibre network of Bujumbura
systems.platform: fibre optic; about USD 15 million on credit from Huawei

note: An article on the decline of the state operator ONATEL; the networks named are backbone and metropolitan fibre in Bujumbura, with no local government office said to be on them.
